entries.german:
Abt Wilhelm und der Konvent von St. Gallen übertragen dem Kloster Feldbach den Zehnten zu Oberbussnang.

Wilhelmus dei gratia abbas 1 totusque conventus monasterii sancti Galli Constanciensis dyocesis omnibus presentium inspectoribus subscriptorum notitiam cum salute. Ut frequen||tius | et uberius persone religiose divino cultui seu obsequio valeant insudare, necessarium et pium est, cum spiritualia sine temporalibus subsistere nequeant, ipsis in hiis, || que ad cottidiani | victus usum pertinent, salubriter providere. Noverint igitur universi tam posteri quam presentes, quod cum nobilis vir Eberhardus de Burgelon 2 miles decimam || sitam in opido, quod | vulgariter Obernbussenank 3 nuncupatur, quam a nobis seu a nostro monasterio tam ipse quam sui progenitores ab antiquo in feodum tenuerunt et a tanto tempore, cuius non extat memoria, quiete et pacifice possederunt, ad manus nostras pure et simpliciter resignavit, adhibita in resignatione ipsa omni verborum ac gestuum sollempnitate debita et consueta, petens a nobis humiliter ac devote, ut decimam memoratam divine pietatis et retributionis intuitu sub censu annuo videlicet dimidie libre cere nobis et nostris successoribus in festo beati Galli annis singulis exsolvendo . . dilectis in Christo . . abbatisse et conventui monasterii in Veltbach 4 ordinis Cisterciensis dyocesis supradicte nomine sui monasterii concedere dignaremur, ab eisdem tenendam et possidendam perpetuo cum omni utilitate et usufructu, quo ipsam possedit hactenus pacifice et quiete. Nos petitioni predicti a) nobilis equitatis ducti semita condescendere cupientes, prefatam decimam cum suis pertinentiis universis, prehabito super hoc inter nos tractatu sollempni debito et consueto, qui in huiusmodi concessionibus adhibendus et premittendus est iuxta canonicas sanctiones, consensu unanimi ac spontanea voluntate . . prelibatis . . abbatisse et conventui sub censu supradicto nobis nostrisque successoribus in termino predicto perpetuo persolvendo concedimus ab ipsis ipsorumque monasterio tenendam et possidendam in perpetuum et irrefragabiliter cum omni utilitate et usufructu pacifice et quiete, adhibita in concessione huiusmodi verborum et gestuum sollempnitatibus debitis et consuetis. Et ut premissa concessio nullo unquam b) possit tempore violari, renuntiamus circa ipsam tam pro nobis quam successoribus nostris, qui pro tempore fuerint, benefitio restitutionis in integrum, litteris a sede c) apostolica vel aliunde impetratis seu etiam impetrandis, defensioni non adhibite sollempnitatis, omni consuetudini generali vel particulan, privilegio fori, omnibus constitutionibus editis vel edendis, exceptioni doli, quod metus causa, auxilio cuilibet tam canonum quam legum et generaliter omni suffragio tam in specie quam in genere, quo mediante ea, que premissa sunt, vel ipsorum quodcumque possent quovis ingenio violari. Et in evidentiam omnium premissorum ipsorumque perpetuam firmitatem presens instrumentum de nostro consensu et unanimi voluntate confectum et conscriptum . . prelibatis . . abbatisse et conventui tradimus sigillorum nostrorum una cum appensione sigilli Eberhardi nobilis memorati robore communitum. Acta sunt hec apud sanctum Gallum presentibus domino Diethelmo de Gvttingen 5 milite, Egelolfo, Rv odolfo et Eglolfo d) fratribus de Rôsenberg 6, Walthero dicto Lesting rectore e) in Heriso vwe 7, Rv odolfo de Rôsenburg f)8, Ottone de Einwile 9, Hainrico et Cv onrado dictis Omen 10, anno domini M°.CC°.LXXXXIII°. III a. non. marc. indict. VI a. Ego vero Eberhardus miles predictus omnia, que premissa sunt, confiteor esse vera sigillum proprium in ipsorum evidentiam presentibus appendendo.

Siegel: A 1 3 Siegel an Schnüren, rest., 1. Abb. 93; 2. Abb. 94; 3. wie 1. in Nr. 2203. - A 2 3 Siegel an Schnüren, rest., wie in A 1.
entries.english:
Abbot Wilhelm and the convent of St Gall transfer the tithe at Oberbussnang to Feldbach Abbey.

Wilhelm, by the grace of God abbot, and the entire convent of the monastery of St Gall in the diocese of Constance, send greetings and make known the following to all who inspect this document. It is necessary and pious, since spiritual things cannot subsist without temporal support, to provide religious people with what they need for daily sustenance, so that they may devote themselves more often and more fully to divine worship. Let all, present and future, know that the noble knight Eberhard von Burgelon has purely and simply resigned into our hands the tithe situated in the town commonly called Oberbussnang, which he and his ancestors held as a fief from us or our monastery from ancient times and possessed peacefully and without interruption for as long as anyone can remember. Having made this resignation with the customary legal formalities of words and actions, he humbly and devoutly asked us, in view of divine mercy and reward, to grant the said tithe to the beloved abbess and convent of the Cistercian monastery at Feldbach in the aforesaid diocese, to be held and possessed perpetually by them and their monastery with all the use and benefit which he had peacefully enjoyed, on payment to us and our successors of an annual rent of half a pound of wax on the feast of St Gall each year.

Wishing to grant the request of the aforesaid nobleman in accordance with justice, after the solemn deliberation required by canon law for such grants, and with unanimous consent and free will, we grant the aforesaid tithe with all its appurtenances to the abbess and convent, to be held and possessed by them and their monastery in perpetuity, peacefully and without disturbance, with all its use and benefit, on payment to us and our successors of the aforesaid rent at the stated time. We renounce, for ourselves and our successors, any right to challenge this grant by appeal to restitution in integrum, letters obtained or to be obtained from the Apostolic See or elsewhere, lack of formalities, custom, privilege of forum, existing or future constitutions, fraud, duress, or any other provision of canon or civil law that might invalidate these terms. As evidence and for the perpetual validity of all the foregoing, we give the present instrument, made with our consent and unanimous will, to the abbess and convent, authenticated by our seals and by the attached seal of the aforesaid Eberhard.

Done at St Gall in the presence of Lord Diethelm von Gůttingen, knight; Egelolf, Rudolf, and Eglolf, brothers von Rosenberg; Walther called Lesting, rector at Herisau; Rudolf von Rosenberg; Otto von Einwil; Heinrich and Cunrad called Omen; in the year of the Lord 1293, on 5 March, indiction 6. I, the aforesaid knight Eberhard, acknowledge as true all the foregoing and attach my own seal in testimony.
